correctness.rationale: For exact complex homogeneous harmonic degree 2, reconstruct the traceless-symmetric quadratic representation with t=x1²+x2² distributed Beta(1,(n−2)/2), φ independent uniform, and z-orthogonal fourth moments. The invariant decomposition has blocks span{t−2/n,x1²−x2²}, 2x1x2, x1 z_j, x2 z_j, and tracefree z-quadratics. The nontrivial normalized 2×2 Gram block is [[L,sqrt((n−2)/n) sin L],[same,L+sin L cos L]]/(2π). The remaining blocks have eigenvalues (L−sin L cos L)/(2π), (L±sin L)/(2π) with multiplicity n−2, and L/(2π) with remaining multiplicity (n−2)(n−1)/2−1. Its top branch crosses (L+sin L)/(2π) exactly at cos L=2/n, and the proposed eigenfunctions S+wC and x1z_j follow by unnormalizing the block eigenvector; the n=3 transverse zero dimension and complex eigenspaces are covered. A separate direct 1.5-million-point n=3,L=1 sphere-Monte-Carlo moment calculation reproduced the two-block entries within 3.01×10^-4, as corroboration only. The exact moments and matrix eigenvalue comparison, not Monte Carlo, prove all n and L.
